title: 烟花粒子
desc: 点击演示区，绽放带辉光的绚丽烟花。
code:
<canvas id='c'></canvas><script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d');
function boom(cx,cy){
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const a=i/60*Math.PI*2,s=2+Math.random()*5;
    let p={x:cx,y:cy,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,l:1,h:Math.random()*360};
    (function f(){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.06;p.l-=0.015;
      if(p.l>0){x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,3,0,7);x.fillStyle='hsla('+p.h+',90%,60%,'+p.l+')';x.shadowBlur=12;x.shadowColor='hsla('+p.h+',90%,60%,1)';x.fill();requestAnimationFrame(f);}})();
  }
}
c.addEventListener('click',e=>boom(e.offsetX,e.offsetY));
</script>

<canvas id='c' style='background:#000'></canvas><script>

let fs=[];setInterval(()=>{for(let i=0;i<4;i++)fs.push({x:c.width/2+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:c.height,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.5,vy:-Math.random()*4-2,l:1,s:3+Math.random()*5});},40);

title: 黑洞漩涡
desc: 粒子螺旋吸入中心，形成黑洞。
demo: demo(el){ const c=makeCanvas(el),x=c.getContext('2d');let ps=Array.from({length:200},()=>({a:Math.random()*7,r:50+Math.random()*200,s:0.01+Math.random()*0.03,h:Math.random()*60+200}));(function a(){if(!c.parentNode)return;x.fillStyle='rgba(5,5,12,0.15)';x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);let cx=c.width/2,cy=c.height/2;ps.forEach(p=>{p.a+=p.s;p.r*=0.99;if(p.r<4){p.r=250;p.a=Math.random()*7;}let X=cx+Math.cos(p.a)*p.r,Y=cy+Math.sin(p.a)*p.r;x.beginPath();x.arc(X,Y,1.5,0,7);x.fillStyle='hsl('+p.h+',90%,'+Math.min(80,p.r)+'%)';x.shadowBlur=4;x.shadowColor='hsl('+p.h+',90%,60%)';x.fill();});requestAnimationFrame(a);})();return ()=>{}; }

title: 星座连线
desc: 移动鼠标，节点自动连线成网。
demo: demo(el){ const c=makeCanvas(el),x=c.getContext('2d');let ns=Array.from({length:50},()=>({x:Math.random()*c.width,y:Math.random()*c.height,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.5,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.5}));let mx=-99,my=-99;c.onmousemove=e=>{mx=e.offsetX;my=e.offsetY};(function a(){if(!c.parentNode)return;x.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);ns.forEach(n=>{n.x+=n.vx;n.y+=n.vy;if(n.x<0||n.x>c.width)n.vx*=-1;if(n.y<0||n.y>c.height)n.vy*=-1;});for(let i=0;i<ns.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<ns.length;j++){let dx=ns[i].x-ns[j].x,dy=ns[i].y-ns[j].y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<90){x.beginPath();x.moveTo(ns[i].x,ns[i].y);x.lineTo(ns[j].x,ns[j].y);x.strokeStyle='rgba(120,200,255,'+(1-d/90)+')';x.lineWidth=1;x.stroke();}}if(mx>-99){x.beginPath();x.arc(mx,my,4,0,7);x.fillStyle='#ff6b9d';x.fill();}ns.forEach(n=>{x.beginPath();x.arc(n.x,n.y,2,0,7);x.fillStyle='#7cf';x.fill();});requestAnimationFrame(a);})();return ()=>{c.onmousemove=null;}; }

(function a(){t+=0.01;x.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);let cx=c.width/2,cy=c.height/2;for(let i=0;i<70;i++){let ang=t+i*0.12;let r=i*4;x.beginPath();x.arc(cx+Math.cos(ang)*r,cy+Math.sin(ang)*r,2.2,0,7);x.fillStyle='hsl('+((i*6+t*60)%360)+',80%,60%)';x.shadowBlur=4;x.shadowColor=x.fillStyle;x.fill();}requestAnimationFrame(a);})();
</script>
